Meilisearch._ApiKeyUidComment: Set Search:Meilisearch:ApiKeyUid to the uid of the API KEY you sign tenant tokens with. Meilisearch will not sign a tenant token with the master key, so this is a real, separately-provisioned search key — see the README. Left unset here: the sample reports search.meilisearch.tenant_token_issuance_failed with an actionable message, which is itself worth seeing.
